text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. Wonder Acute shows her gentle 
side by looking after a nervous junior. 
Her fighting spirit, too, is beyond 
reproach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer watches closely, wondering 
what today's match will bring to Wonder 
Acute.
